displayName: SVG Find element ID by coordinates

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, 'pictureObject' below is an object name (pass a string); if omitted, 'pictureObject' is a Variable/Field reference.

params.name: pictureObject
params.description: Object name (if '*' passed) or Field/Variable reference (if '*' omitted)

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the id (or xml:id) of the topmost SVG XML element located at pixel coordinates (x,y) within the designated SVG picture.

constraints: The object-name ('*') syntax requires the picture to actually be displayed in a form; if it is not displayed, you must use the Variable/Field-reference overload instead.
